response.justification: While this candidate demonstrates exceptional technical depth and directly relevant developer tools/infrastructure experience, the role is explicitly a full-time people-leadership position requiring 2 years of people management experience. The resume shows zero evidence of team leadership, performance management, hiring, or organizational responsibilities. This candidate is a highly skilled technical individual contributor, but lacks the critical management competencies required for a Level II Manager role.
strengths: Deep technical expertise spanning full-stack development with proven developer tools and infrastructure experience (CI/CD setup, GitLab administration, MCP frameworks, test automation libraries)
Extensive background in build systems, testing infrastructure, and code quality through open-source projects (GISCollective, Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts testing library)
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing ability through multiple workshops, courses, and active open-source contributions across 19+ years of software development
concerns: No evidence of people management, team leadership, or direct reports—this is a hard requirement for a manager role, not just preferred
All career positions appear to be individual contributor roles without described organizational leadership or strategic decision-making responsibilities
No evidence of setting team priorities, conducting performance reviews, establishing performance expectations, or driving organizational change initiatives

key_factors.factor: Complete absence of people management experience
Strong developer tools and infrastructure technical background
No demonstrated strategic leadership or organizational planning experience
